question: What bodily condition results from the nectar that removes aging signs?
premises: The nectar destroys wrinkles and gray hair.
The practitioner becomes freed from wrinkles and gray hair.
The practitioner becomes devoid of all diseases.
inference: Through this nectar the practitioner attains freedom from aging marks and all diseases.
plain_english: One becomes freed from wrinkles and gray hair, and devoid of all diseases.
